    // setmetatable returns its table, so a local initialized with the call is the
    // table: members written to it afterward -- the prototype idiom -- are members of
    // the table, and reads through the pairing still see them.
    local Builder = { build = function(self: { name: string }) return self.name end }
    local Panel = setmetatable({}, { __index = Builder })
    function Panel.panel(self: table) return 1 end
    local Stack = setmetatable({}, { __index = Panel })
    function Stack.stack(self: table) return 2 end
    Stack.count = 0 -- a store, not a declaration: checked against the pairing
          ~~~~~
